title: Mastermind of Maharashtra TET Paper Leak Arrested, Investigation Ongoing
summary: The mastermind behind the leak of the Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) paper has been arrested in Patna, while another suspect is still at large. The police have launched a crackdown on several states, including Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, to apprehend those involved in the scam. The arrest is seen as a significant step towards resolving the issue, but the investigation is ongoing.
summary_points: The mastermind behind the leak was arrested in Patna, while another suspect is still at large.
The police have launched a crackdown on several states to apprehend those involved in the scam.
The arrest is seen as a significant step towards resolving the issue, but the investigation is ongoing.
The Maharashtra TET paper leak has affected over 4.5 lakh students who took part in the exam.
The police are still investigating the case and gathering evidence to build a strong case against those involved.
